'''1999 San Diego Comic-Con Invitational''' was the Star Wars CCG invitational tournament at the 1999 San Diego Comic-Con, an event of about 80 players. [[Clayton Atkin]] beat [[Ryan Hase]] in the final.<ref name="trando-iv8">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041026204829/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/iv8.htm Ryan Hase interview], [[Trandosite]] (4 September 2000)</ref> Hase later posted his Light deck from it on DeckTech, calling it "the deck that I used at the comic con invitational of San Diego last year".<ref name="dt-7331">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7331 Undefeated invitational Harvest], DeckTech (Ryan "heinekin" Hase, 7 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7331/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7331/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[1999 San Diego Comic-Con Invitational Ryan Hase Undefeated invitational Harvest]] ([[Ryan Hase]], [[Light]]; 4–0) — "The deck won all 3 of its regular games" and beat Clayton Atkin's Dark deck "thus going undefeated at an 80 man event"
